question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 17 days and B can do the same job in 12 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Total Work** be the **LCM** of 17, 12, and 3 = 204 units.

**Efficiency** of A = 12, B = 17, and (A+B+C) = 68.

**Efficiency** of C = 68 − (12 + 17) = 39.

**Time** taken by C = 204 ÷ 39 = 68 ÷ 13 = 5(3/13) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5(3/13) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = 17 days, **B** = 12 days, **(A+B+C)** = 3 days.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = Efficiency × Time | 1/Tₜₒₜₐₗ = 1/TA + 1/TB + 1/TC

⇒ Efficiency of **A + B + C** = 68

⇒ 12 + 17 + Efficiency of **C** = 68

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 68 − 29 = 39

⇒ Time taken by **C** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of **C**

⇒ Time = 204 ÷ 39 = 68/13 days

⇒ Time = 5(3/13) days

**∴ The correct answer is 5(3/13) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is always assumed to be the **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** of the individual days to simplify calculations into integers.

Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken. If a person is twice as efficient, they take half the time to complete the work.

Work and Wages

When people work together, the **wages** are distributed in the ratio of their **efficiencies** or the actual work done by each.</p
